findings.location: Table 1 E4 caption ('mean reading error of her three points ... one point is partly hidden')
findings.finding: The cutoff-1 marker of the E4 cell was not read: secondary/digitize_raster_figures.py found no marker for it (status 'occluded') and set its value to the mean of the two visible markers (0.0683, 0.0571 -> 0.0627) and its 'reading error' to max marker radius plus max deviation (0.0187). The paper calls it 'partly hidden' and treats 0.063 and 0.0187 as readings: page 1 caption 'mean reading error of her three points ... one point is partly hidden'; p.6 'Her Figure 4.28 gives 0.063, 0.068 and 0.057 in the contrast cell at cutoffs 1-3'; p.7 'the tolerance, 0.0123, is the mean reading error of her three points'; pp.5, 17, 19 'the two directly read points give the same mean (.063) ... so no label changes', which is identical by construction and not an independent check. The published effect 0.0127 is in fact the mean of the two directly read points, and an honest measurement tolerance is their mean reading error 0.00915 (0.0091 rounded down). Labels are unchanged (0.0127 > 0.0091: 'larger', 'same direction'), so the verdict stands, but the tolerance basis and one published number are misdescribed.
